method.arms: One tree, no worktree. git archive of 784a9bdd0's src/sim/bots (the live 2026.11.18 bots; deploy/assets/index-DkC8mzIG.js carries planPings and no sayObjective, so live is that code) into src/sim/_vfy10_live; HEAD's sim and my own throwaway pair script _harness/_tmp_vfy_ai10_pair.ts (VALE_BOTS picks the bots folder; the switches set on the loaded tier profile before the first match). Arms: live (784a9bdd0 bots, untouched); off (HEAD, every new switch off incl. sayObjective); ship (HEAD as committed: sayObjective on); join (joinAt 3/2/2 alone); mates (hearMatesAssist alone, adept and veteran); all (joinAt + sayObjective + hearMatesAssist). Both folder and script deleted afterwards.
method.seeds: RIFT s1101-1132 (32 a tier per arm), BRIDGE s1101-1112 (12 a tier per arm: live, off, ship, all). None overlap the implementer's s701-764 / s901-932 or r9's s1001-1032. The tactics probe's lineup, both teams one tier, cut at 30:00, paired by seed. 52 jobs, about 750 games, all under heavy.py (3 at a time).
method.person: Person proxy: seat 0 played by the bots but registered in its team brain as a person; from 15:00 it pings 'help here' every 45 s on its teammate nearest an enemy fighter (within 12 m). RIFT s1101-1108 per tier on live and ship. I read the team-0 ping feed and every 'heading there' with whether the sayer came within 12 m inside 10 s. Plus probe_sim_bot_pings --seed0 1101 --seeds 8 per tier on HEAD and on the live bots.
method.measures: Game length (end or 30:00), games at 30:00, late stalls (gaps of 3+ min with no structure damage by fighters or their units from 14:00 to the end, a game), lone deaths from 14:00 (no living teammate within 20 m), team 0 wins and paired winner flips, full-event hash and non-ping-event hash. Join: from 14:00 two fit (50 %+) fighters of a team within 22 m of an enemy non-core structure, a third arrives within 20 s. Objective: another teammate not within 30 m at the ping comes within 30 m inside 10 s; contested = the team damages a camp unit within 25 m inside 30 s; repeat = the same team pings the same camp again inside 60 s. Mates' help: a bot's 'help here' gets 'heading there' from another teammate within 30 m inside 5 s AND a teammate 15 m+ away reaches 12 m inside 5 s; for each 'heading there' to a mate, the sayer's mode at that moment and its last non-defend mode in the 4 s before (push / objective / teamfight / protect / hunt, or on a post/base answer = 'left a team job').
method.not_done: No real-browser run this round: the shipped change is sim-only pings that the HUD already draws through the live path ('{name} marks an objective'), and r9 looked at that path in a real client. The 5v5 feed check was scripted (person proxy) and read as text.

problems: The owner's main asks are still not delivered: 'if 2-3 go into a line, all should join' (piece 1) and teammates answering each other's 'help here' (piece 3) both stay off. The build adds only 'take this' pings; attack and defence play exactly as live.

Piece 1 on fresh seeds: pace is fine (pooled +0.07) but the third-arrives rate is not better than live (49/64/61 % vs 52/58/59 %), novice misses 'at least half', and novice stalls and lone deaths rise slightly. A join that helps needs the free fighters' walk to end in a hit, not a re-pointed siege.

Piece 3's mode filter leaves almost no answerers: 'heading there' plus an arrival inside 5 s is 4-6 %, a tenth of the 45 % bar, and it reshuffles game outcomes (adept -1.54, veteran +1.16 min on my seeds vs +1.14 / +0.62 for the implementer).

Novice 'marks an objective' is followed 51 % but the camp is actually hit within 30 s only 36 % of the time (adept 66 %, veteran 63 %). Not a broken promise (it is a mark, not 'on my way'), but the weakest of the three.
Minor: 3 of 504 (adept) and 3 of 567 (veteran) objective pings repeat the same camp within 60 s although the key holds for 60 s.
Pre-existing, same as live: at veteran a third of 'heading there' sayers are not at the spot inside 10 s (64 %), likely long walks at assistReach 55 m.
